# Phase 1b DEV inference environment (shard jobs), Python 3.12, linux x86_64, CPU only.
#
# Resolved with uv (pip compile, --generate-hashes, --only-binary :all:) from:
#   transformers==5.24.0, cryptography==50.0.2, numpy==2.2.6 and the torch 2.7.1 install
#   requirements at their historical versions (setuptools 84.2.1, patched).
# The historical runs used transformers 4.55.4 (inference-requirements.lock.txt on branch
# repro/phase1b-dev-env-2026-11-12, see reproducibility/phase1b-dev-2026-11-07/), which has
# published high-severity advisories fixed only in 5.x. The CI workflow
# phase1b-inference-equivalence.yml runs the exact shard code for mDeBERTa, MiniCheck and
# FactCG under both environments and requires the same chunking and scores within 1e-5,
# with no decision change at 0.5.
# nltk is not installed: the shards use the nltk 3.9.4 segmentation vendored in
# scripts/benchmarks/phase1b/vendor_nltk/ (docs/audit/P4-NLTK-EQUIVALENCE-2026-11-28.md).
# PyTorch CPU is locked in requirements-phase1b-torch-cpu.txt (official CPU index).
#
# Install: pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: --no-deps \
#   --index-url https://pypi.org/simple -r requirements-phase1b-inference.txt
